components.name: Selected device menu row
components.description: A visual example of the encoder-selected row on the device; navigation is hardware-controlled.
components.css: .ds-menu { background:#101014; padding:6px; width:280px; color:#fff; font:12px monospace; } .ds-menu-row { background:#3a2a10; text-align:center; padding:3px 8px; }

narrative.overview: MINIMOD should look at home on the MPC Sample: dark, compact, direct, and focused on the sound. Promos use the same amber and near-black foundation, with a larger type scale and more space for a phone screen. The hardware and the work remain the heroes.
dos: Keep the original MPC Sample look and control language recognizable.
Verify feature behavior, shortcut names, and hardware/emulator claims against the current code and documentation.
Check exported frames at phone size and listen to the actual mix; test the device UI on its target screen or an accurate emulator.
Give labels and state changes enough contrast and distinguish status with words as well as color.
donts: Do not crowd a small screen or a Short with multiple competing messages.
Do not imply a control action occurred if the footage only describes it.
Do not replace the actual interface or sound with a fabricated demonstration.
Do not use an octave claim for an eight-semitone shift; state the real increment.
